key_expressions: I'd like to make a medical appointment,
How will the test results come out?,
How should I take the medicine?,

A: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment. Is that possible?
Then what is the earliest time available?
Great, please book that time for me.
B: Hello! Yes, I can help you with that.
The earliest slot is today at 3 p.m.
Alright, your appointment is confirmed!

A: I've been coughing a lot lately, and I'm a bit worried.
Yes, the symptoms have gotten worse over the past few days.
Okay, I'll go ahead with the test.
B: I see. When did the coughing first start?
In that case, it could be a cold or bronchitis.
Let me guide you to the testing room.

A: Will the test results be ready soon?
Oh, that’s quicker than I expected!
Okay, please let me know as soon as they’re out.
B: Yes, you can usually get them in about 20 minutes.
We should be able to inform you right away.
I'll call you as soon as we have the results.

A: Could I get a prescription?
My symptoms are pretty strong, so I think I need some medication.
Great, thank you. I'll go to the pharmacy now.
B: Yes, based on your symptoms, medication would help.
I'll prescribe cough medicine and an anti-inflammatory.
Your prescription has been printed.

A: Should I take the medicine after meals?
Oh, so I just need to follow the timing properly.
Alright, I’ll make sure not to forget.
B: Yes, it works best if taken 30 minutes after a meal.
Keeping the timing consistent helps with effectiveness.
Let me know if you need further explanation.

A: Could you check if I have a fever?
Wow, that’s higher than I thought…
Then should I get an injection too?
B: Sure, let me take your temperature.
It's over 38 degrees, so you do need something for the fever.
Yes, a fever-reducing injection will help.

A: Does this include allergy medication too?
Ah, that’s good. My allergies have been pretty bad lately.
Okay, I’ll be careful.
B: Yes, I also prescribed an allergy reliever.
Then the symptoms should ease a bit.
It may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving.

A: Is there a pharmacy inside this building?
Oh nice, right next door makes it convenient!
Great. I’ll head there now.
B: Yes, there’s a pharmacy on the first floor.
There usually isn’t much waiting time.
Once you get your medicine, you’re all set.

A: Could I receive the test results by email as well?
Nice, that will make it easier to keep track.
Okay, please send them to me.
B: Yes, we can email them to you.
You’ll receive them as a PDF, so you can view them anytime.
Please confirm your email address and I'll send them right away.

A: How do I pay for the consultation today?
Oh good, card payment works!
Okay, I’ll pay now and head out.
B: You can pay at the front desk.
Yes, we accept both card and cash.
Here’s your receipt. Wishing you a quick recovery!
